## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Tang-dynasty commentary on the *Fànwǎng jīng* by **Chuán Ào** 傳奧 ([傳奧](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%82%B3%E5%A5%A7)). The work belongs to the broader Huāyán-influenced Tang exegetical tradition.

**Abstract**

Chuán Ào's commentary is a representative example of mid-Tang scholastic literature on the *Fànwǎng jīng*, working within the Huāyán-Cí'ēn 慈恩 synthesis that characterised the period after [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's *Fànwǎngjīng púsàjièběn shū* ([KR6k0080](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0080)) foundational commentary.
